title: Principia Mathematica is modern and insightful
summary: Oleg Kiselyov's article examines why Whitehead and Russell's Principia Mathematica remains relevant to modern computer science, exploring connections between classical mathematical logic and contemporary programming language theory, type systems, and formal verification techniques.
problem_solved: Demonstrates how foundational work in mathematical logic from 1910-1913 continues to provide deep insights for modern programming language design and computational theory.
why_valuable: Bridges classical mathematical foundations with modern computing, showing how timeless logical principles can inform contemporary software development and formal verification.
